front: What proportion of Earth's total water is available as usable freshwater?
back: If all water on Earth were placed in a 200 ml glass, usable freshwater equals only about 5 ml (roughly one teaspoon or ~2.5%). The remaining ~97.5% is salty ocean water.
key_takeaway: Usable freshwater makes up only ~2.5% (5 ml out of 200 ml) of Earth's total water.
